    Your Security Code

    ℹ️ What is this code and how to use it?
    🔒 This Security Code is used when you forget your Admin Dashboard password.
    📋 Steps to use: Go to Login page → Click "Forgot Password?" (red button) → Enter your Admin ID → Enter this Security Code → Set a new password.
    🔄 This code changes automatically every time it is used. A new code is generated after each password reset.
    ⚠️ Keep this code private. Do not share it with anyone. Only the Admin should know this code.
    📝 It is recommended to note this code somewhere safe in case you need it in the future.

    📨 When the Super Admin/support team needs to access your account (for help or bug-fixing), you'll get a popup right here on your dashboard to Accept or Reject it.

    💾 Export & Backup

    📄 PDF Report is a human-readable summary of your library — great for printing or record-keeping, but it can't be restored back into the app.

    🗂 JSON Backup holds your complete data (students, tickets, configuration, wallet, and everything else) and is the file you should keep if you ever need to restore your library.

    📌 Note: Your downloaded JSON Backup file is saved to your device's usual Downloads location. If you don't see it there right away, open your File Manager app, use its Search option, and type the file name — it will show up.

    ⚠️ Restoring will replace your current library data with the contents of the backup file, and the page will reload afterwards. This cannot be undone.

    📌 Note: If the file picker doesn't show your JSON Backup file straight away, use the file picker's own search box and type the file name — it will show up so you can select it.
